note: A real unauthenticated GET of api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World after 59 earlier unauthenticated calls from the same address spent the hourly allowance (the REST API's primary rate limit). The caller's address in the message was replaced by a documentation address; nothing else was changed. The reset time is a real one from that moment: a test that needs a limit that has not lifted yet replaces X-RateLimit-Reset, never anything else.

body.message: API rate limit exceeded for 203.0.113.7. (But here's the good news: Authenticated requests get a higher rate limit. Check out the documentation for more details.)
